caption: The video frame at 120 ms may be paired with audio anywhere in the ±80 ms window, 40 to 200 ms. Case (a): audio at 150 ms gives skew +30 ms, inside the window. Case (b): audio at 230 ms gives skew +110 ms, outside it, so the player delays video by 110 ms.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds: a grey allowed window runs from 40 to 200 ms around the video frame at 120 to 160 ms; audio at 150 to 190 ms lies inside the window, while audio at 230 to 270 ms lies outside it.
